description: The Idempotency-Key grammar of the public IdempotencyKey and OptionalIdempotencyKey parameters (API-R69): 1 to maxLength ASCII bytes matching [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*. contracts.ValidIdempotencyKey, the public handlers (including Managed Eval mutations, which answer 422 eval_invalid), the CLI's explicit --idempotency-key, the OpenAPI parameter schemas and the UI hold to these cases. Consumers also check a key of maxLength bytes (valid) and of maxLength+1 bytes (invalid), each ending with every allowed punctuation character. duplicateHeaders lists header value sets that are not exactly one Idempotency-Key header: every one is invalid, even when each value is valid.
